newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr steady in heavy post-FOMC meeting trade.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr steady in heavy post-FOMC meeting trade.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed virtually flat at C$1.3667 (US$0.7317) in heavy trading Tuesday from Monday's close at C$1.3665 (US$0.7318). * The currency firmed after the U.S. Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, but closed flat on fears the Bank of Canada might cut Canadian rates, dealers said.
"There's a pretty good tone to the currency now," he said.

With the question of U.S. rates out of the picture until November and stronger Canadian economic data cutting the chances the Bank of Canada will move to ease monetary conditions, the Canadian dollar is poised to gain strength, he said.
"Monetary policy maneuvers were the key risk to the Canadian dollar, either Bank of Canada easing or the Fed tightening," Gregory said.
"This risk to the currency has been removed, at least temporarily."
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar weakened to 1.0981 marks from Monday's close of 1.1066 marks and slid to 79.81 yen from 80.37 yen.
